description: This is a test class for BusinessDateReadPlatformService, testing various scenarios such as finding by type, handling non-existent types, and retrieving all business dates. It uses Mockito for mocking dependencies and JUnit 5 for testing.

classes.name: BusinessDateReadPlatformServiceTest
classes.description: Test class for BusinessDateReadPlatformService, verifying behavior of methods such as findByType and findAll, as well as exception handling for non-existent types.

methods.name: notFoundByTypeNonexistentType
methods.description: Tests that finding by an invalid type throws BusinessDateNotFoundException with the correct message.

methods.name: notFoundByTypeNotStoredInDB
methods.description: Tests that requesting a type not stored in the database throws BusinessDateNotFoundException with the expected message.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Tests that calling findAll retrieves all BusinessDate entities and maps them properly.

methods.name: findByCOBType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a BusinessDate by type COB_DATE.

methods.name: findByBusinessType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a BusinessDate by type BUSINESS_DATE.
